title: maint.event.v1{kind=dlq_replay}
description: Phase 8 §8.5 — operator instructs the DLQ supervisor to replay messages on a single topic's DLQ. `target` is the DLQ topic (e.g. 'predict.vote.dlq'). The supervisor refuses topics in its `RECURSION_DENY_SET` (the maint plane's own DLQs).

target.description: DLQ topic to replay (must end in '.dlq').

max_msgs.description: Cap on messages replayed in this run; 0/absent uses cfg.
